blocks.accepted_litex:
thm topology_binary_union:
    ? forall [TopologicalSpaceSetting], open_A, open_B T:
        union(open_A, open_B) $in T
    have family power_set(power_set(X)) = {candidate power_set(X): candidate = open_A or candidate = open_B}
    claim:
        ? family $subset T
        claim:
            ? forall candidate family:
                candidate $in T
            candidate $in {choice power_set(X): choice = open_A or choice = open_B}
            candidate = open_A or candidate = open_B
            by cases:
                ? candidate $in T
                case candidate = open_A:
                    candidate $in T
                case candidate = open_B:
                    candidate $in T
        by def:
            ? family $subset T
    family_union(family) $in T
    by extension:
        ? family_union(family) = union(open_A, open_B)
        claim:
            ? forall point family_union(family):
                point $in union(open_A, open_B)
            obtain candidate from exist candidate family st {point $in candidate}
            candidate $in {choice power_set(X): choice = open_A or choice = open_B}
            candidate = open_A or candidate = open_B
            by cases:
                ? point $in union(open_A, open_B)
                case candidate = open_A:
                    point $in open_A
                    point $in union(open_A, open_B)
                case candidate = open_B:
                    point $in open_B
                    point $in union(open_A, open_B)
        claim:
            ? forall point union(open_A, open_B):
                point $in family_union(family)
            point $in open_A or point $in open_B
            by cases:
                ? point $in family_union(family)
                case point $in open_A:
                    open_A = open_A or open_A = open_B
                    by thm set_builder_member(open_A, {choice power_set(X): choice = open_A or choice = open_B})
                    open_A $in family
                    point $in family_union(family)
                case point $in open_B:
                    open_B = open_A or open_B = open_B
                    by thm set_builder_member(open_B, {choice power_set(X): choice = open_A or choice = open_B})
                    open_B $in family
                    point $in family_union(family)

setting ContinuousCompositionSetting:
    A, B, CarrierC set
    T_A power_set(power_set(A))
    T_B power_set(power_set(B))

    forall open_B1, open_B2 T_B:
        intersect(open_B1, open_B2) $in T_B

    CarrierC $in T_C
    forall open_C1, open_C2 T_C:
        intersect(open_C1, open_C2) $in T_C
    forall family_C power_set(power_set(CarrierC)):
        family_C $subset T_C
        =>:
            family_union(family_C) $in T_C
    forall open_B T_B:

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm continuous_composition:
    ? forall [ContinuousCompositionSetting]:
        $is_continuous(A, CarrierC, T_A, T_C, fn(x A) CarrierC {g(f(x))})
    claim:
        ? forall target_open T_C:
            {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open} $in T_A
        {y B: g(y) $in target_open} $in T_B
        have middle_open T_B = {y B: g(y) $in target_open}
        {x A: f(x) $in middle_open} $in T_A
        have nested_preimage T_A = {x A: f(x) $in middle_open}
        have direct_preimage power_set(A) = {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open}
        claim:
            ? nested_preimage $subset direct_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point nested_preimage:
                    point $in direct_preimage
                f(point) $in middle_open
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {x A: g(f(x)) $in target_open})
            by def:
                ? nested_preimage $subset direct_preimage
        claim:
            ? direct_preimage $subset nested_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point direct_preimage:
                    point $in nested_preimage
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(f(point), {y B: g(y) $in target_open})
                f(point) $in middle_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {x A: f(x) $in middle_open})
            by def:
                ? direct_preimage $subset nested_preimage
        by extension:
            ? nested_preimage = direct_preimage
        direct_preimage $in T_A
    claim:
        ? forall target_open T_C:
            {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open} $in T_A
        have direct_preimage T_A = {candidate A: g(f(candidate)) $in target_open}
        have literal_preimage power_set(A) = {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open}
        claim:
            ? literal_preimage $subset direct_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point literal_preimage:
                    point $in direct_preimage
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) = g(f(point))
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {candidate A: g(f(candidate)) $in target_open})
            by def:
                ? literal_preimage $subset direct_preimage
        claim:
            ? direct_preimage $subset literal_preimage
            claim:
                ? forall point direct_preimage:
                    point $in literal_preimage
                g(f(point)) $in target_open
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) = g(f(point))
                fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(point) $in target_open
                by thm set_builder_member(point, {candidate A: fn(argument A) CarrierC {g(f(argument))}(candidate) $in target_open})
            by def:
                ? direct_preimage $subset literal_preimage
        by extension:
            ? literal_preimage = direct_preimage
        literal_preimage $in T_A
    by def:
        ? $is_continuous(A, CarrierC, T_A, T_C, fn(x A) CarrierC {g(f(x))})
